name: agent-panel
about: An agent at work in lab-sandbox from a Code chat, its cards allowed: shots of the Agent panel beside the chat and the thread's to-do card while it runs and once it's done, in both themes. Then a plan nobody acts on: Needs you while it waits, and "Plan not used" in Finished (not Needs you) once a newer agent runs in the same Code chat. Its `fake` steps play only in a --fake lab (the stand-in agent), so the script's own flow can be checked offline.

args.brief: Add tablespoons to src/convert.js (1 tbsp = 15 ml) with a test, run the tests, then tick that item in TODO.md.

fake.content: On it: I've sent an agent to lab-sandbox.

steps.ask: Send an agent to do the first unticked item in TODO.md: add tablespoons to src/convert.js (1 tbsp = 15 ml) with a test, run the tests, then tick that item in TODO.md. Have it keep a short to-do list as it works.

steps.note: The Agent tab beside the chat while the agent works.
The thread's to-do card, live (only when the agent keeps a to-do list).
The to-do card shows only when the agent kept a to-do list.
A plan nobody acted on (8 Nov 2026: an old plan stayed in Needs you for ever, below a newer turn already running).

args.brief: Make a plan for adding teaspoons to src/convert.js (1 tsp = 5 ml). Read only: change no files.
args.title: Read only, don't change any files

fake.content: On it: a fresh agent in lab-sandbox is making a plan.

steps.ask: Read only, don't change any files: start a fresh agent that makes a plan for adding teaspoons to src/convert.js (1 tsp = 5 ml).

steps.note: Until it asks (the plan's prompt; the stand-in's step).
Not yet: the turn ends with its plan, which is left waiting (no more cards answered).
The plan waits on its latest turn, nothing newer: Needs you, with Go ahead / Not yet in its row.

args.brief: Add teaspoons to src/convert.js (1 tsp = 5 ml) with a test, and run the tests.
args.title: Add teaspoons

fake.content: On it: a fresh agent in lab-sandbox is adding teaspoons.

steps.ask: Leave that plan for now. Start a fresh agent: add teaspoons to src/convert.js (1 tsp = 5 ml) with a test, and run the tests.

steps.note: The newer agent at work: the old plan no longer in Needs you.
No plan waits in Needs you now (the newer agent's own step to allow may: that one truly waits); the old plan is in Finished.
The plan nobody acted on is "Plan not used", in Finished, not Needs you.
